text:
**Sunday**, and the show is behind you. The week ahead is short: no school on **Wednesday** for Veteran's Day.

After school it is ASL Club on **Monday**, Jr. Thespians and then Tae Kwon Do on **Tuesday**, and Crochet Club on **Friday**. It is Gear Week at Tae Kwon Do, so arrive already in your full gear.

Your Biology review presentation is on the **18th**, with the slides and five questions due the day before. Wednesday's day off is an unhurried place to build the slides, which leaves today free to do nothing much at all.
